comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. Coordinates are real OSM lat/lon projected via road.project(). radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters (~30% of real). Entries marked needs_owner_review:true have uncertain coordinates or boundaries — owner's lived knowledge is authoritative. IDs are stable from creation for the future ad/analytics system.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow barrier spit connecting the airport to the mainland — sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Major community at the eastern end of the Palisadoes — roundabout marks the gateway to Kingston

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial community on Windward Road, site of Rockfort Mineral Bath

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Community along Mountain View Avenue, close to the National Stadium

communities.name: Rollington Town
communities.note: Inner-city community adjacent to Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Jamaica's capital and commercial hub

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's business district — offices, hotels, Emancipation Park

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The crossroads of uptown Kingston — clock tower, courts, market

communities.name: Constant Spring
communities.note: Uptown suburb along Constant Spring Road

communities.name: Washington Gardens
communities.note: Residential community west of Half Way Tree

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Former capital of Jamaica and St. Catherine parish capital

communities.name: Waterford
communities.note: Community between Kingston and Spanish Town on the highway

communities.name: Caymanas
communities.note: Caymanas Estate area — sugar cane and horse racing heritage

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Community at the mouth of the Rio Cobre gorge — Flat Bridge is nearby

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small St. Catherine community in the gorge hills

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: St. Catherine market town — the song 'Linstead Market' is named for it

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: St. Ann border town at the crest of the hills — cool air, misty mornings

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival

communities.name: Claremont
communities.note: St. Ann community on the descent toward Ocho Rios

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: The famous fern-canopied gorge road dropping into Ocho Rios — bamboo arches overhead

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: St. Ann resort town — cruise ships, Dunn's River Falls, journey's end
